about: A tool for following requests as they move through many services, to find where things are slow or failing.

prs.title: Repeated spans no longer leave empty entries in a trace
prs.broken: When the same piece of a trace arrived twice, for example after a retry, Jaeger removed the copy but kept the empty groups that had held it. Its newer trace API then returned entries with nothing in them.
prs.changed: After removing copies, I made it also remove any groups left empty.
prs.matters: Tools that read traces from Jaeger get only real data, with no empty entries to trip over.
